excerpt: Is New Zealand Honey Co. legit? Where it's based, how its UMF grading and batch tracing work, its store ratings, prices by grade, and the return rules for opened honey.

lede: New Zealand Honey Co. is a Manuka honey company based in Mount Maunganui, New Zealand, that sells UMF-graded raw Manuka honey in jars, squeezy bottles and single-serve packets, and ships to the US from its own warehouses. Here's what it sells, what its reviews say, how its grading works, and who it suits.

parts: New Zealand Honey Co. is a real company with a published address in New Zealand, US and NZ phone numbers, written shipping and refund policies and thousands of reviews on its own store. Its honey carries the independent UMF grade, and the batch number on each jar links to that batch's lab results on its site. The catch is the price of the higher grades and a return policy that excludes opened honey.

sections.h2: What New Zealand Honey Co. sells
parts: Mostly raw Manuka honey in seven UMF grades, from UMF 10+ (MGO 263+) at $18.88 for 250g to UMF 30+ (MGO 1620+) at $600 for 250g. Most grades come in 125g, 250g and 500g jars, a 500g squeezy bottle and boxes of 10 single-serve packets. It also sells honey drops, a throat spray with propolis, a Manuka honey for pets, a wooden spoon ($3.99) and kits that bundle a jar with packets and drops.

The brand says its honey is cold-extracted and unpasteurised, and certified non-GMO, glyphosate-free and halal. Those are the brand's statements; the UMF grade is the part checked by an outside body. Like all honey, it isn't suitable for babies under 12 months.

parts.small: Checked on November 26, 2026. Store reviews are collected and shown by the brand itself, so treat them as a showcase rather than an independent score. We couldn't find or load a Trustpilot page for the brand that day.

parts: The store reviews are almost all 5-star and mostly praise the taste, the thick texture and fast US delivery. Because they're hosted by the brand and there's no independent review site with a meaningful count, we can't give you a balanced complaint picture. The things buyers most often get caught by on any honey shop are the return rules for opened jars and subscription renewals, so read both before you order.

sections.h2: Is New Zealand Honey Co. legit?
parts: Yes. Its contact page lists a street address at 75 Maunganui Road in Mount Maunganui, a New Zealand and a US phone number, and its products carry the UMF quality mark, which is licensed by New Zealand's UMF Honey Association. Each jar has a lot number you can enter on its site to see that batch's test results. Orders are tracked, and US orders ship from a US warehouse in 1 to 3 business days, according to its shipping policy.

It depends on the grade. UMF 10+ at $18.88 for 250g is priced like an everyday Manuka honey; UMF 24+ and above cost several times more per jar for a higher measured MGO. If you want Manuka honey for eating, the lower grades and the 500g jars give you the most honey for the money. The Black Friday sale (up to 30% off until December 1, 2026) and Subscribe & Save (20% to 25%) cut the price more than most codes.
Our [New Zealand Honey Co. discount code guide](saving-tips-new-zealand-honey-co-discount-code.html) lists every way to pay less, with prices side by side.

list: UMF-graded Manuka honey with batch test results you can look up
Seven grades and sizes from 125g to 500g
Free shipping over $30 and 1 to 3 day US delivery
High grades are expensive ($600 for 250g of UMF 30+)
Opened honey can't be returned unless damaged or defective
No independent review site with a meaningful number of reviews

parts: Shoppers who want genuine UMF-graded Manuka honey shipped quickly within the US and like being able to check a jar's lab results. If you just want honey for baking or sweetening, regular honey is far cheaper; if you want Manuka, start with a 125g or 250g jar of a lower grade before buying a 500g jar of a high one.
